I'll start by reading the execution file and the referenced documentation.
Now I have the full picture. I'll write the docs checker first, then the documents it validates, then its tests.
The required REL-4 checks pass. A full E2E run surfaced pre-existing failures unrelated to documentation, so I'm correcting the release checklist to avoid claiming a green suite.
I'll add direct evidence for the base-path deep link by loading it in Chromium against the production preview.
## REL-4 report

### Files created or changed

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `README.md` | Replaced with the product summary, requirements, install/dev/test/preview flows, script table, quality gates, Pages deployment, privacy model, backup/restore, browser/device support, known limitations, and documentation links. |
| `docs/RELEASE.md` | Created with version/date, split automated/human checklist, CI gates, human gates, hard success signal, post-v1 pilot, changelog, and open release risks. |
| `scripts/check-release-docs.mjs` | Created the release-docs checker: headings by level, local links and anchors, required commands, package-script/script-file drift, placeholders, and forbidden claims. |
| `tests/release/releaseDocs.test.ts` | Created 15 tests covering the real documents and every required failure mode. |

No product code, execution file, or `docs/artifacts/` file was changed.

### Required validation commands

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `node scripts/check-release-docs.mjs` | **Exit 0** — README has 16 headings, 11 local links, 16 required commands; RELEASE has 13 headings, 3 local links, 11 required commands. |
| `npm test -- tests/release/releaseDocs.test.ts` | **Exit 0** — 15/15 tests pass. |

The tests prove the checker fails on missing headings, broken local links, missing required links, bad heading anchors, missing commands, `TODO`/`TBD`/`example.com` placeholders, missing npm scripts, missing script files, and claims of end-to-end encryption, cloud sync, or screen-reader canvas parity.

### Additional release evidence

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `VITE_BASE_PATH=/notes-detective/ npm run build` | Exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-pages-build.mjs --base /notes-detective/` | Pass — base `/notes-detective/`, all assets prefixed, manifest `start_url "./"`, `scope "./"`, 192/512/maskable icons resolve |
| Direct deep link against preview | `http://127.0.0.1:4174/notes-detective/#/settings` returned HTTP 200, rendered H2 “Settings”, manifest URL `http://127.0.0.1:4174/notes-detective/manifest.webmanifest` |
| `node scripts/perf-budget.mjs` | Pass — **88.1 KiB** initial JavaScript ≤ 300 KiB |
| `node scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs` | Pass — **10.90 MiB** precache ≤ 25 MiB (67 entries) |
| `node scripts/validate-workflows.mjs` | Pass |
| `npm run lint` | Exit 0 — 0 errors, 3 pre-existing `RecallSummary.tsx` fast-refresh warnings |
| `npm run typecheck` | Exit 0 |
| `npm run test:coverage` | Exit 0 — 90 test files pass; domain/data thresholds hold |
| `npm run test:e2e` | **Exit 1** — 69 passed, 19 failed, 13 skipped; the PWA install/offline/update spec passed at all three Chromium viewports |

### Release gate status

- **Human gate remains open.** No `docs/reviews/final-acceptance.json` was created or approved; the tablet/phone/desktop journey and the “would you choose this over re-reading your notes” answer require a human reviewer.
- **Deployment is not verified.** No GitHub Pages deployment was run in this task, so there is no deployed URL or production build identity to report. The release checklist leaves the CI/deployment items unchecked.
- **Full E2E is not green and is recorded as a release blocker in `docs/RELEASE.md`.** Failures clustered in board drag/pan, capture, connection drawing, several phone layouts, and one search keyboard path; they are unrelated to the documentation changes but must be resolved or proven environmental before release.
- The git remote is `study-detective` while the task examples use `/notes-detective/`; the deploy workflow derives the base path from the repository name, so the actual deployed path must be verified after deployment.
